body.p: Once the Live Tutorials add-on is installed, the Tutorials view is available by selecting it from the Window Show View menu.
The Roadmap is the main interface of the add-on, where all the available tutorials are presented along with the actions that can be triggered regarding the tutorials.
The Roadmap panel includes the following actions/features:

dd.p: This is a list of all the available tutorials. Each tutorial is an entry, with its own progress icon displayed on the left side. The following actions are available in the Tutorials list:

dlentry.dd: Double-click, press ENTER, or right-click and choose Start mission on any selected mission to begin a new mission. Missions can be started in any order.
Right-click on a mission and choose Reset progress to reset its current progress.

dlentry.dt: Learn how to create your own tutorials help link
dlentry.dd: Opens the user guide help pages of the add-on in the preferred browser.

dlentry.dt: Learn how to create your own tutorials link
dlentry.dd: Opens the user guide of the add-on in the preferred browser.

body.p: Once a mission is opened from the Roadmap, the Tutorials view changes to display the selected mission.
The Mission Progress panel shows the overall status of the current mission. The following actions/features are available:

dlentry.dd: Navigates back to the Roadmap missions list.

dd.p: Opens the collapsible/expandable Hints pane that gives you access to various hints to help you complete the current mission.
The Hints pane has the following features:

dlentry.dd: Opens a visual file comparison tool with the current mission's edited file on the left side and the expected file content from the finished tutorial on the right side.
Presents details about the current hint.
Details are displayed in the mission panel about what the mission consists of and the steps needed to complete it.
